🎬 Edge of Darkness (2010) — Crime, Mystery, Thriller
Thomas Craven is a Boston detective whose life is shattered when his daughter is killed outside his home. At first, he believes he knows what happened, but as he begins investigating the circumstances surrounding her death, he discovers that she may have been involved in something far more dangerous than he ever realized.
Determined to uncover the truth, Craven follows a trail of hidden connections that leads him into a world of political corruption, corporate secrets, and powerful people willing to protect their interests. The deeper he investigates, the more dangerous his search becomes, but his grief pushes him forward.
The film explores grief, justice, corruption, family, betrayal, and the lengths a parent will go to uncover the truth. Craven's investigation becomes more than a search for answers—it becomes a personal fight against people who believe their power can keep them protected.
More than just a crime thriller, Edge of Darkness is an emotional story about a father confronting loss while refusing to stop until he discovers what really happened to his daughter. ❤️‍🩹
💬 If you discovered the truth behind a loved one's death, would you risk everything to expose it? 👇
